name: Sportarr
description: Sportarr is a sports automation tool that follows your favorite teams and athletes, matches new releases from your indexers (Prowlarr/autobrr) and pushes them to your download client — including optional IPTV DVR.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Sportarr configuration, database and settings. Host folder must be chowned to 99:100 to match the --user override.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Media library root folder. Keep downloads under the same mount so imports can hardlink instead of copying.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the container runs as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the container runs as.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File permissions mask for created files.
